values.note: Operator's ResNexus booking page, one night for 2 adults on 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-15: RV sites $65 standard rate (sites 21, 22 and 28 $75); primitive tent sites $35. Plus 8% lodging tax. Dump station free with an overnight RV reservation ($20 otherwise). The rates page says posted rates are 'as of 7/23/2026'.

fees.source: https://resnexus.com/resnexus/reservations/book/8516AC50-EBEB-4F98-98F7-92195B3B9748/?NewSearch=1&StartDate=6/15/2027&EndDate=6/16/2027 ('Standard Rate $65.00 / night' on RV sites 01-20 and 27, '$75.00 / night' on 21, 22, 28, 'Primitive Tent Site $35.00 / night') + https://perrysrv.com/?page_id=19 ('All sites are subject to a 8% lodging tax', dump station, '(Current posted rates are as of 7/23/2026.)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 50 RV sites and 20 tent sites (plus 7 cabins), upper and lower areas, most shaded near Rock Creek. ResNexus RV site lengths 25-74 ft; sites 01-06 are pull-throughs up to 74 ft.

sites.source: https://perrysrv.com/?page_id=21 ('We have 50 RV campsites, 20 tent campsites, and 7 cabins. Most sites are shaded and near Rock Creek') + ResNexus site list ('01 RV Site - Pull Through Length: Up to 74 ft.' ... '28) RV Site Length: Up to 25ft.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: New accessible shower house; beer, wine, ice and other items and an ATM in the office.

facilities.source: https://perrysrv.com/?page_id=21 ('Bathrooms with hot showers', 'An RV dump station is also available', 'Wifi service is now available!') + https://perrysrv.com/?page_id=19 ('Beer, wine, ice and other items are available in the office', 'Laundry facilities are also available in the office'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://perrysrv.com/ ('We are open from May 25 until October 1.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online through the operator's ResNexus page ('Book Now!') or by phone (406) 446-2722. Cancel up to 24 hours ahead; later cancellations or no-shows may be charged $25.

booking.source: https://perrysrv.com/ ('Book Now!' link) + https://perrysrv.com/?page_id=64 ('Please call us at (406) 446-2722 to check on availability and make reservations') + https://perrysrv.com/?page_id=19 (Cancellation Policy), read 2026-10-22

note: Private RV park 2 mi S of Red Lodge on US-212 (Beartooth Highway), upper and lower campsites mostly shaded along Rock Creek; tent sites and 7 simple cabins too. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its ResNexus booking page: base $65 (RV sites, 2027 dates; some $75), 50-amp/water, open May 25 - Oct 1, showers/dump/laundry/Wi-Fi/store, reservable online. Changed site count 59 -> 70 (50 RV + 20 tent), added 74-ft max and pull-throughs. Not stated: sewer, discounts. Note corrected (old counts) and trimmed.
